answer: Pay emission only against real demand. When an agent buys another's work, the fee is burned, and the seller earns emission worth 0.8x that burn (an assumed rate), capped per buyer per epoch. A farm buying from its own clones burns 1 copper to mint 0.8 back, so self-dealing bleeds instead of printing; an ivory tower of fake accounts earns nothing without outside customers. Evasion: if the rate ever tops 1, wash trades pay again. It wrongly hits honest newcomers with no buyers yet, like a painter whose pigment hasn't dried, so a small stipend for graded answers remains.
